content_sections.heading: About Hindi University
content_sections.text: Hindi University is a university in Howrah, with its office at ALO Building, 37/2 Bhairab Dutta Lane, Nandibagan, Salkia, Howrah, 711106. This engagement is being made under a re-employment scheme for competent retired government, quasi-government or government undertaking officials or persons, or their equivalent.

content_sections.heading: Hindi University Registrar Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: Retired persons in between 60 to 65 years of age. Educational qualification: Uniformly good academic record with a Master's degree with minimum 55% of marks or its equivalent grade in the point scale wherever a grading system is followed. Experience: Candidates must meet one of these four conditions: At least 15 years of experience as Sr. Lecturer, Reader or Asst. Professor in the AGP of Rs. 7000/- and above, or eight years of service in the AGP of Rs. 8000/- and above including as associate Professor. This must come with experience in educational administration in an academic institution like a university or an institute of higher learning, of which five years must be in a university or in an institution of post graduate study. Comparable experience in research establishments and other institutions of higher learning. 15 years of administrative experience, of which eight years as a Deputy Registrar or equivalent post. High level of administrative experience in government, quasi-government or government undertaking, or a good background in administration and management in a senior position. The University reserves the right to relax experience in exceptional cases. See the official notification for the complete eligibility wording for this post.

rows.event: Last date to email the application

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through an interview or interaction. The University reserves the right to conduct a written or screening test if the number of applicants for the post is large. Meeting the eligibility conditions does not by itself give a candidate the right to be called for interview. The University's decision in all matters will be final.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment will initially be for six months, subject to the approval of the Department of Higher Education, Government of West Bengal. Based on performance, the tenure may be extended further till the attainment of 65 years of age. The University reserves the right not to fill the advertised post without assigning any reasons.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Hindi University Registrar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed bio data, complete in all respects, with your contact number and email ID. Combine the bio data and all supporting documents into a single PDF. Address the application to the Registrar, Hindi University, Howrah. Email the PDF to [email protected] before the deadline. Incomplete applications, applications without proper supporting documents and those received after the last date are liable to be rejected. No TA/DA shall be paid to candidates, no interim enquiries will be entertained, and no correspondence will be entertained about the selection process or interview.

faq.question: Q1. Can I attend the interview without applying first?
faq.answer: The notice asks interested candidates to send their bio data and documents by email, and it says eligibility alone does not guarantee an interview call. Applications received after 10 November 2026 are liable to be rejected.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for the Registrar post?
faq.answer: The post is for competent retired government, quasi-government or government undertaking officials or persons, or their equivalent, who are between 60 and 65 years of age.

faq.question: Q3. What marks are required in the Master's degree?
faq.answer: Candidates need a minimum of 55% of marks or an equivalent grade in the point scale, along with a uniformly good academic record.

faq.question: Q4. Can administrative experience qualify instead of teaching experience?
faq.answer: Yes. One accepted route is 15 years of administrative experience, including eight years as a Deputy Registrar or equivalent post.

faq.question: Q5. How long will the appointment last?
faq.answer: It will initially run for six months. It may then be extended on the basis of performance, until the appointee reaches 65 years of age.

faq.question: Q6. Will a written test be held?
faq.answer: It may be. The University can hold a written or screening test if it receives a large number of applications for the post.

faq.question: Q7. In what format should the application be sent?
faq.answer: The bio data and all supporting documents must be sent together as a single PDF, not as separate attachments.

faq.question: Q8. Will travel costs for the interview be paid?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA shall be paid to candidates.
